principle: Derived verification criteria are generated from the write scope of a requirement or story and never replace the explicit acceptance criteria, which keep priority. A project overrides this default with the verification_policy key of .sdlc/config.json: top-level fields replace these, and rules are merged by id (set enabled to false to drop one, or add new ids).

rules.criterion: Automated tests cover the units and modules touched by this work and pass.
rules.evidence_hint: run the project's unit test suite (e.g. npm test) and save its output as the log.

rules.criterion: An end-to-end test drives the running app as a user would through the flow described by this work and checks usability: the flow completes without dead ends and gives clear feedback.
rules.evidence_hint: run the end-to-end suite (Playwright/Cypress) against the running app over the touched flow and save the report.

rules.criterion: A basic accessibility check (automated scan plus keyboard navigation and labels) passes on the screens touched by this work.
rules.evidence_hint: run an automated accessibility scan (axe/pa11y/Lighthouse) on the touched screens plus a keyboard pass and save the report.

rules.criterion: Integration or contract tests exercise the API or integration boundaries touched by this work and pass.
rules.evidence_hint: run the integration or contract tests (supertest/pact/newman) for the touched API boundaries and save the output.

rules.criterion: Every step documented or demonstrated by this work is executed as written and works.
rules.evidence_hint: execute every documented or demo step as written (smoke script or transcript) and save the output.
